Testing

Running Tests

Option 1: Using the script (recommended)

From the project root:

./scripts/run-tests.sh

This script automatically:

  • Uses docker compose run --rm backend pytest -sv tests if Docker is available

  • Otherwise runs pytest -sv tests locally inside backend/

Option 2: With Docker

docker compose run --rm backend pytest -sv tests

Option 3: Locally

cd backend
pytest -sv tests

A successful run shows all tests as PASSED.

Test Suite Summary

All tests are located in backend/tests/ and follow pytest conventions.

File

Module Tested

Purpose

test_data.py

fivedreg.data

Data loading, preprocessing, splitting

test_model.py

fivedreg.model

API endpoints (upload, train, predict)

test_data.py

Tests for the data handling module (fivedreg.data).

test_load_dataset

  • Creates a temporary .pkl file with X (100x5) and y (100,)

  • Calls load_dataset() and verifies:

    • Total samples across train/val/test equals 100

    • All splits have 5 features

    • Feature mean and std arrays have length 5

test_load_dataset_fails

  • Creates a .pkl file with wrong number of features (3 instead of 5)

  • Verifies load_dataset() raises ValueError

test_handle_missing_values

  • Creates data with NaN values in both X and y

  • Verifies:

    • Rows where y is NaN are dropped

    • NaN values in X are replaced with column means

    • No NaN values remain in cleaned data

test_split_and_standardise

  • Creates a 120-sample dataset

  • Calls split_and_standardise() and verifies:

    • All splits have correct dimensions (5 features)

    • Feature mean/std arrays have length 5

    • Training data has approximately zero mean and unit std

test_load_from_bytes

  • Creates pickled bytes from a valid dataset

  • Verifies load_from_bytes() returns correct shapes

test_load_from_bytes_fails

  • Creates invalid pickled bytes (missing required keys)

  • Verifies load_from_bytes() raises ValueError

test_model.py

Tests for the neural network model (fivedreg.model).

test_neural_network_init

  • Creates a NeuralNetwork with specific hyperparameters

  • Verifies all attributes are set correctly:

    • input_dim=5

    • hidden_layers=[10, 5]

    • learning_rate=1e-3

    • max_epochs=10

    • batch_size=8

test_neural_network

  • Creates a small synthetic dataset (50 samples)

  • Trains a NeuralNetwork for 5 epochs

  • Verifies predictions have correct shape (50,)

test_main.py

Tests for the FastAPI endpoints (main.py).

test_health_endpoint

  • Calls GET /health

  • Verifies:

    • Status code is 200

    • Response contains {"status": "ok"}

test_train_fails

  • Calls POST /train without uploading a dataset first

  • Verifies:

    • Status code is 400

    • Error message contains “No dataset uploaded”

test_predict_fails

  • Calls POST /predict without training a model first

  • Verifies:

    • Status code is 400

    • Error message contains “Model is not trained yet”

test_full_flow

End-to-end test of the complete workflow:

  1. Upload: Posts a test .pkl file to /upload

    • Verifies status 200

    • Verifies response contains n_samples=100 and n_features=5

  2. Train: Posts training config to /train

    • Verifies status 200

    • Verifies response contains train/val/test sample counts

  3. Predict: Posts 5D input to /predict

    • Verifies status 200

    • Verifies response contains input array (length 5) and prediction (float)
